name: brown-co-services
description: Marketing website for Brown Co Services, terrace contractor in Henderson, Iowa.

scripts.check: tsx scripts/prebuild.mjs && astro check && astro build && tsx scripts/check-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run validate && npm run grep:banned
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run predeploy-guard && npm run build && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run predeploy-guard && npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=brown-co-services
